title: Ask for the location of the faulty window

semantic_requirements.description: Ask which window, room, or location is affected; do not assume its location.
Relate the question to the reported fallen window handle and inability to open the window.
The reason cites event 001 or the initial request.

prohibited_behaviors: Inventing the location of the faulty window.
Calling assign_contractor directly without clear approval and while the location remains unknown.
Rewriting an inability to open the window as a confirmed inability to lock it and an emergency security incident.

input_evidence.excerpt: Request description: Opened the blind above this window this morning and the window handle fell off.... Now unable to open the window.

reference_actions.excerpt:
Address: Flat 21, 129 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ9 4ZZ

Hi Harriet

Which window is this please?

Thanks Grace

provenance.derivation: The initial request and event 001 do not identify the room/window. Historical event 005 asks Which window is this please?; map to send_message(to=tenant). Events 003/004 contain only notes about contacting/waiting for the landlord, not a complete exchange, so do not require a claim that the landlord has received a message or granted approval.
provenance.review_scope: Historical prefix events 001–004 and the reference action; later events are not inputs or required facts.

grading.action_source: Use recorded CaseState.actions or tool entries in traces, not only model statements or the status in ANSWER.md.
grading.rule: The run may take several actions. A successful action must match an allowed branch (name and exact_arguments); the run must end on that action, or on hold or escalate after it (close_case only when it is the matched branch); no guard may refuse an action. Sum semantic_requirements weights over the matched action and normalize to a score from 0 to 4. A prohibited behavior in any action of the run yields 0. History is not the only acceptable answer; alternative paths may be retained for manual review.
grading.tool_error: A failed/refused tool is not successful execution. Record the failure; do not manually fix the answer.
grading.semantic_review: Assess message/argument semantics against the visible input and labels. Do not treat new facts in future reference_actions as facts already known to the agent.
